config.starterErrorModel: uniform integer advances -60 through +60 inclusive, same attempt sequence for paired starters
config.experimentDefinition: one suggested held-item setup, move swap or permanent EV-training checkpoint; initial route preparation and individual pixel answers are counted separately
config.oracle: Independent BigInt RNG and packed 80-byte checksum-valid encrypted record; SID hidden from solver; all 160 curtain cells drawn before filtering
assumptions: Ordinary English Emerald, seed-zero Method 1 starters, no BIOS reset
Perfect TID/SID timing at nominal advance 1245; actual timing uncertainty is not sampled
All six level-5 stats, nature, gender and ability read without mistakes after the first 1-Speed-EV victory
Retry starter until exactly one PID/IV spread matches; no oracle tie breaking
Execute current route planner including the avoidable two-Nincada trainer; one starter receives all listed EXP and EVs
No Pokerus, no EV multipliers, no unlogged battles, no evolution, no PP Ups; PC restores PP
Only the guide's early held items, move swaps and zero-vitamin EV recommendations are allowed
EV experiments create a new full drawing checkpoint, retaining all previous evidence, as the guide currently does
Items/move experiments restore original baseline; EV training is permanent and never reloaded
Extra EV-only route opponents not given a level by the planner are modeled at level 5 for nuisance EXP and friendship; neither is supplied as a known fact

instructions: Avoid all wild battles except any training listed below, and other optional trainers. Check off the listed battles once, rather than recording them again in the battle log. Decline any new moves not listed in this plan.
Defeat the Route 103 rival's level-5 Treecko (+1 Speed EV) using only your starter.
Keep one of the five Poke Balls given by the rival after receiving the Pokedex.
Defeat Youngster Calvin's level-5 Poochyena on Route 102 using only your starter (+1 Attack EV).
Pick up the hidden Heart Scale on the Route 104 south beach.
Defeat the Aqua Grunt's level-9 Poochyena in Petalburg Woods using only your starter (+1 Attack EV).
Keep the Great Ball given by the Devon employee after the Team Aqua battle in Petalburg Woods.

For this beginner route, fight Bug Catcher James in Petalburg Woods: two level-6 Nincada, using only your starter (+2 Defense EVs). He can be avoided, but this plan does not depend on slipping past him.

After the listed trainer battles, defeat exactly 1 level-5 Wurmple in Petalburg Woods with only the starter, to reach level 10 and learn Mud-Slap and Water Gun. Each gives 1 HP EV and no Defense or Speed EVs. Run from other species and levels.
Get TM09 Bullet Seed from the boy south of the Route 104 Flower Shop. Keep the TM; do not teach it.
At the Rustboro Mart when you arrive, buy one each: X ATTACK, ANTIDOTE, PARLYZ HEAL (800 money total).
Get the Quick Claw from the teacher in Rustboro Trainers' School.
Swap occupied move slots 1 and 2 (Tackle / Growl). PP follows its move.
Swap occupied move slots 2 and 4 (Tackle / Water Gun). PP follows its move.
Confirm the starter has these moves in this order: Growl / Water Gun / Mud-Slap / Tackle.
Heal at the Pokémon Center. Check all four current moves before boxing; PC storage restores PP. Cancel evolution during this investigation.
Before depositing, give X ATTACK to the starter. Keep the other listed items in your Bag for later curtain tests.
Place the starter in Box 8, slot 5. Keep slots 4 and 6 empty. Leave and reenter Rustboro Trainer’s School.
